theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) : (⋃ i ∈ t, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard := by
  let u := ⋃ i ∈ t, s i
  have h1 : u.finite := by
    apply Finset.bUnion_finite
    intro i
    exact (s i).finite
  have h2 : (u.ncard : ℕ) ≤ (∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard : ℕ) := by
    rw [ncard_le_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_bUnion_le t s
  exact h2
